subject.title: fix(infra): bound response body read in non-streaming fallback paths

question: Should this PR land the SDK-visible no-reader fail-closed behavior after real proof is added, or should maintainers defer to the proof-sufficient sibling branch?
rationale: The implementation direction is source-supported, but the shared helper backs a plugin SDK export and there are multiple open candidate PRs for the same issue, so the final compatibility and canonical-branch choice needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Require proof and SDK-edge coverage
options.body: Ask the contributor to add real terminal/live proof for this head and focused SDK-exported reader coverage or a PR-body compatibility note before merge.

options.title: Accept the fail-closed tradeoff
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the SDK edge behavior and proof gap if the availability boundary is more important than preserving synthetic no-reader compatibility.

options.title: Defer to the sibling branch
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101270 remains the preferred canonical fix, preserve any useful test ideas here and close or retarget this branch after that path lands.

recommendation.title: Require proof and SDK-edge coverage
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to add real terminal/live proof for this head and focused SDK-exported reader coverage or a PR-body compatibility note before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account merged both the shared bounded-reader work and the adjacent fail-closed fallback precedent, so it is the best available owner for the compatibility/canonical-branch call.
